entities.name: Vojislav Mihailović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vojislav Mihailović is a Serbian politician who served as the mayor of Belgrade from 1999 to 2000. As of January 2022, he has been the president of the Movement for the Restoration of the Kingdom of Serbia (POKS). He is a grandson of Draža Mihailović, the leader of Chetniks during World War II.
